Sales Development Representative (SDR)
Location: Hybrid

About the Role:

As a Senior SDR, you will play a critical role in driving our lead generation and sales pipeline efforts. You will be responsible for identifying, prospecting, and qualifying new business opportunities, primarily in the EMEA and/ or North American markets. You’ll work closely with our sales and marketing teams, utilizing platforms such as HubSpot and Amplemarket, and have the opportunity to evolve into a leadership position as we grow.

 

Key Responsibilities:
Identify and engage potential clients via outbound prospecting (calls, emails, social media, etc.).
Qualify inbound and outbound leads and schedule meetings for the sales team.
Maintain and manage pipeline activities using CRM tools like HubSpot.
Utilize advanced sales tools such as Amplemarket to optimize outreach and engagement.
Collaborate closely with sales and marketing teams to align strategies and messaging.
Consistently meet or exceed KPIs related to outreach and lead qualification.
Provide regular feedback and reports on lead quality, pipeline progress, and market trends.
Potential to grow into the SDR Team Leader role, mentoring junior SDRs as the team expands.

Requirements:

Minimum 5 years of SDR or related sales experience, preferably in a startup environment.
Proven experience in the SaaS technology sector.
Strong command of sales platforms like HubSpot, Amplemarket, and similar tools.
Demonstrated success in working with EMEA and/ or North American regions.
A track record of hard work, accountability, and high performance.
Strong communication, organization, and time-management skills.
Open-minded, challenge-driven, and adaptable in a fast-paced environment.
Leadership potential and a desire to grow into a team leader role.

Lead Software Architect
Location: Hybrid

About the Role:
As the Lead Software Architect, you will be responsible for designing and overseeing the architecture of our software systems, ensuring they meet both current and future business needs. You will work closely with engineering teams, product managers, and stakeholders to deliver scalable, reliable, and high-performance solutions. This role also requires hands-on involvement in the development process, from coding to system deployment.

Requirements:

Extensive experience with Microservices architecture and K8S.
Experience with Technologies like Kafka, Rabbit, Spring, Postgres, MongoDB
Experience with SaaS based solutions
Experience with Java, Python and node development.
Experience with Cloud platforms (GCP/AWS/Azure)
Experience with Networking (advantage)
Proven expertise in designing scalable and high-performance systems.

Senior Java Backend Engineer
Location: Hybrid

About the Role:
As a Senior Java Backend Engineer, you will be responsible for developing, maintaining, and optimizing backend services in a distributed, microservices-based cloud system. You will work closely with software architects, engineering teams, and product managers to build scalable, reliable, and high-performance backend solutions.

Key Responsibilities:
Strong design and development skills, expertise in Java, and proficiency in RESTful APIs, microservices, and cloud-native architectures
We are looking for candidates who are passionate about their work, highly motivated, team-oriented, and eager to contribute to a cutting-edge startup.

Requirements:

5+ years of Java development experience
Experience with Spring and Spring Boot
Experience with Docker and Kubernetes
Experience with cloud environments
Experience with SQL databases (e.g., PostgreSQL) and NoSQL databases (e.g., MongoDB, InfluxDB, Redis)
Experience with message brokers (e.g., Kafka, RabbitMQ)
Networking experience (advantage)
B.Sc. in Computer Science or equivalent studies

Junior Technical Support Specialist
Location: Hybrid

About the Role:
As a Junior Technical Support Specialist at NetOp, you’ll be the first line of support for our clients, troubleshooting technical issues and ensuring their networks run smoothly. This role is ideal for individuals looking to kick-start their career in IT and network management.

Key Responsibilities:
Provide prompt and efficient support to customers via email, chat, and phone.
Troubleshoot and resolve basic technical issues related to network management tools.
Escalate complex problems to senior engineers with clear documentation.
Maintain detailed records of customer interactions and solutions provided.
Assist in testing and documenting new features or updates for the platform.

Requirements:

Basic understanding of networking concepts (IP, DNS, routers, switches).
Excellent problem-solving and communication skills.
Eagerness to learn and grow in the field of IT support.
Relevant certifications (e.g., CompTIA Network+) are a plus but not required.
